verdict.rationale: Community evidence indicates Zapier supports more than one simultaneous IF/THEN condition compared to IFTTT (zapier-comm-8), implying some conditional/branching capability, but no documentation in the pack describes explicit 'Paths', filters, or parallel-path merge-back features, and users explicitly flag 'the need for escape hatches/conditional logic when needed' and frustration at lacking simple 'if' logic (zapier-comm-11, zapier-comm-13) as ongoing gaps. Missing for 10: first-party docs on Paths/filter steps, evidence of parallel branch execution, and confirmation that branches can merge back into a single continuing workflow.
